english_draft: SK hynix reported FY2025 revenue of 97.1467 trillion won, operating profit of 47.2063 trillion won, and net profit of 42.9479 trillion won under K-IFRS. The release date is January 28, 2026, and the press release is the official source. All figures are in Korean won, billion won units in the table, and K-IFRS basis. FY2024 revenue was 66.1930 trillion won, operating profit was 23.4673 trillion won, net profit was 19.7969 trillion won. Annual revenue grew 47%, operating profit grew 101%, net profit grew 117%. Operating margin changed from 35% to 49%. Net margin was 44%. For 4Q25, revenue was 32.8267 trillion won, operating profit was 19.1696 trillion won, and net profit was 15.2460 trillion won. Revenue grew 34% quarter-over-quarter and 66% year-over-year. Operating profit grew 68% quarter-over-quarter and 137% year-over-year. Operating margin was 58%. The record was driven by AI memory demand including HBM, plus increased demand for conventional server DRAM and NAND. HBM revenue more than doubled year-over-year. HBM4 mass production preparation completed in September 2025. The company announced an additional dividend of 1 trillion won, equivalent to 1,500 won per share. Total FY2025 dividends reached 2.1 trillion won, or 3,000 won per share. The company also planned to cancel 15.3 million treasury shares, about 12.2 trillion won based on the January 27 closing price, equivalent to 2.1% of total shares outstanding. No same-period Preview was written before this release.
